verdict.rationale: Docs show org-level defaults applied across all connected repos with repo-level overrides for exceptions (qodo-docs-10), plus configuration-as-code via .pr_agent.toml at repo/project/group/org scope (qodo-docs-11) and centralized rule enforcement with Rule Miner (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-13), directly matching the rollout-and-exceptions workflow. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of managing hundreds of repos at scale, and more detail on audit/visibility of exceptions across the org beyond the history/health view (qodo-docs-15).
